Unica-owned guidance skill. Prose is written for Unica. Normative posting rules are reconciled against v8std through public unica.standards.* (std450, std477, std603, std661, std663, std664, and diagnostics acc:105, acc:123, acc:226, acc:227); document property names are cross-checked against plugins/unica/references/specs/1c-config-objects-spec.md. Informed conceptually by the public 1Ci knowledge base tutorial 'Practical developer guide 8.3' (https://kb.1ci.com/1C_Enterprise_Platform/Tutorials/Practical_developer_guide_8.3/); its write-empty-sets-then-read-balances posting shape was rejected as contrary to std450/std661 and is not reproduced. No donor expression was copied or adapted.

Unica-owned guidance skill. Prose is written for Unica. Normative rules are taken from v8std through public unica.standards.* (std447, std477, std657, std661, std663, std664, std708, std733, std792, and diagnostics acc:123, acc:229, bslls:DenyIncompleteValues, bslls:VirtualTableCallWithoutParameters, v8cs:ql-virtual-table-filters, v8cs:register-resource-precision); register XML property names are cross-checked against plugins/unica/references/specs/1c-config-objects-spec.md section 9. The std664/std733 totals-separation trade-off is stated as a trade-off because the two standards pull opposite ways. No donor expression was copied or adapted.

Unica-owned guidance skill. Prose is written for Unica. Normative rules are taken from v8std through public unica.standards.* (std396, std455, std463, std464, std465, std466, std686, std752, std773, and diagnostics acc:75, acc:144, acc:1340, acc:1341, bslls:DataExchangeLoading, bslls:UsingCancelParameter, bslls:EventHandlerOutsideEventRegion, bslls:MissingEventSubscriptionHandler, v8cs:data-exchange-load, v8cs:event-handler-boolean-param). Unica-owned guidance skill covering where code is hosted. Prose is written for Unica. Normative rules are taken from v8std through public unica.standards.* (std455, std469, std474, std486, std556, std679, std697, std724, std725, std746, and diagnostics acc:73, acc:80, acc:83, acc:84, acc:85, acc:90, acc:125, acc:363, acc:435-439, acc:444, acc:1245, bslls:CommonModuleInvalidType, bslls:CommonModuleNameWords, v8cs:common-module-server-call). Unica-owned guidance skill covering the object class choice and attribute typing. Prose is written for Unica. Normative rules are taken from v8std through public unica.standards.* (std432, std443, std468, std474, std531, std587, std603, std649, std677, std697, std704, std728, std746, and diagnostics acc:93, acc:192-195, acc:304, acc:305, acc:1205, acc:1207, acc:1210-1217, acc:1329, acc:1330, v8cs:db-object-anyref-type, v8cs:db-object-ref-non-ref-type). The claim that enumeration values are metadata rather than data is cross-checked against plugins/unica/references/specs/1c-config-objects-spec.md section 16. Register internals stay in register-design, posting in document-posting, handlers in object-events, hosting in module-placement; the boundary is stated in the skill. Unica-owned guidance skill owning transaction shape, managed locks and responsible reading across the surface. Prose is written for Unica. Normative rules are taken from v8std through public unica.standards.* (std460, std490, std648, std659, std661, std783, and diagnostics acc:66, acc:67, acc:325-332, acc:415, acc:478, acc:521, acc:1319, acc:1320, acc:1327, acc:1328, bslls:PairingBrokenTransaction, bslls:BeginTransactionBeforeTryCatch, bslls:CommitTransactionOutsideTryCatch, bslls:WrongUseOfRollbackTransactionMethod, v8cs:lock-out-of-try, v8cs:ql-using-for-update). Introducing it removed the duplicated lock guidance from references/platform/platform-mechanics.md and document-posting.md; document-posting keeps only the std661 posting order, register-design only dimension-driven parallelism, background-jobs only restartability, db-performance only the evidence side. No donor expression was copied or adapted.

Unica-owned guidance skill covering concurrency between users editing the same object. Prose is written for Unica. Unlike the rest of this layer the primary source is platform behaviour, not a standards cluster: the mechanism is taken from the official 1C:Enterprise 8.3.27 Developer Guide, chapter 9.2.2 Object locking (sections 9.2.2.1-9.2.2.4, public at https://kb.1ci.com/1C_Enterprise_Platform/Guides/Developer_Guides/), and the one normative rule about taking an object lock from code is std490 through public unica.standards.*. The document states which half rests on which source and tells the reader to re-verify behaviour for the target platform version. Transactional locking stays in transactions-locks, which now carries the qualifier that a failed object lock does not require a rollback. No donor expression was copied or adapted.
